name: River Development Agent Controlled Execution Closure Foundation
architecture: GENERATION III CONTROLLED EXECUTION CLOSURE FOUNDATION
invariants: DEV-280 consumes only the exact DEV-279 controlled execution finalization result contract.
DEV-280 denies closure when the DEV-279 predecessor is malformed, untrusted, unready, unfinalized, blocked, inconsistent, or missing required finalization evidence.
DEV-280 creates deterministic closure data only.
DEV-280 does not execute or re-execute an operation.
DEV-280 does not retry execution.
DEV-280 does not invoke an executor.
DEV-280 does not persist lifecycle state.
DEV-280 preserves the exact approved execution scope.
DEV-280 preserves predecessor provenance, execution evidence, receipt evidence, lifecycle evidence, completion evidence, and finalization evidence.
DEV-280 does not expand execution scope.
DEV-280 does not create new execution authorization.
DEV-280 does not modify repository content.
DEV-280 does not delete repository content.
DEV-280 does not stage repository changes.
DEV-280 does not commit.
DEV-280 does not push.
DEV-280 does not deploy.
DEV-280 does not access secrets.
DEV-280 does not perform arbitrary shell execution.
DEV-280 does not perform network execution.
DEV-280 does not perform external side effects.
Rejected predecessor payloads release no trusted predecessor payload.
A future explicit controlled execution archive boundary is required before downstream progression.
